mapper.update: update purchase_invoice_line set del = 1 where corpid = #{corpid} and purchase_invoice_id = #{invoiceId} and del = 0
mapper.select: select id, corpid, purchase_invoice_id, line_no, product_id, product_name, specification, unit_name, quantity, unit_price, tax_rate, untaxed_amount, tax_amount, amount, remark, creator_id, modify_id from purchase_invoice_line where corpid = #{corpid} and purchase_invoice_id = #{invoiceId} and del = 0 order by line_no asc, id asc
